name: TankLevel
description: Scale the raw level of a tank to metres and hold it near a set point.

local.name: LevelF
local.comment: The raw level as a REAL

local.name: SetF
local.comment: The raw set point as a REAL

local.name: DrainF
local.comment: The raw drain value as a REAL

local.name: Err
local.comment: Set point minus level, in m

local.name: Band
local.comment: 5 percent of the set point, in m

local.name: Lo
local.comment: Lower edge of the green band, in m

local.name: Hi
local.comment: Upper edge of the green band, in m

outputs.name: FillCmd
outputs.comment: Tank1.fill: 0 to 100 percent of the inlet valve

outputs.name: DrainCmd
outputs.comment: Tank1.drain: 0 to 100 percent of the discharge valve

outputs.name: Green
outputs.comment: StackLight1.green: the level is within 5 percent of the set point
